Dial in a roast

Enter the green bean and a starting profile. You get a new .kpro whose name and description carry the bean id, so the roast log that comes back tells you which coffee it was.

Suggested edits

Heuristics are directional, not measured: they nudge the energy keys from density, moisture, altitude, process and load. One roast with the diff tells you whether the nudge helped.
